subject: Animation
title: Wish and the Anniversary Stumble
description: A quick win: understand Wish and the Anniversary Stumble.

hook.text: Disney made Wish to celebrate its hundredth anniversary, packing it with callbacks and references.

buildup.text: The studio designed the film's look as a tribute to classic Disney watercolor backgrounds.

discovery.text: Critics and audiences found the story generic and the characters forgettable despite visual ambition.

twist.text: Wish underperformed on a $200 million budget. Disney's centennial film was a box-office disappointment.

climax.text: The stumble forced Disney to reconsider whether nostalgia alone could sustain its animated future.

punchline.text: Disney's birthday party flopped at the box office.

quiz.question: What went wrong with Disney's Wish?
options: Despite visual ambition, the story felt generic and the film underperformed financially
It was never completed or released
